description: This PHP source file implements a web page for VoIP settings related to a 'Hidden' VoIP feature. It includes header and utility files, displays a UI for toggling the 'Sky Disconnect Line Current Until Registered' option, and handles AJAX requests to save the configuration.

methods.name: Dm_data_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the 'Disable Loop Current' setting from device services.
